items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 11:145:1
items.html: Their external vessels, with the phase of their internal and surrounding Nefesh: This clarifies the matter of what causes the changes of the Mochin and the Tzelem of Mochin between Ibur and nursing, and greatness, and likewise for the second greatness and Yechida. For since in all the couplings of ZON, AVI and YESHSUT are bound to return and become one Partzuf, until even AVI shine with the illumination of Hochma like YESHSUT, as above in Part 10 at length — if so, what then do the differences of the degrees of ZA depend on? And to this he answers: that the difference of the degrees depends on the measure of the MAN of ZA, for AVI always couple in accordance with the MAN of ZON that rose and were included in them. And if the MAN of ZA is in the phase of the Ibur, then AVI couple in the phase of their external vessels, which are from the phase of the Nefesh within them, for the phase of the smallness of Nefesh is aroused in them, and they measure the level of the ten Sefirot of ZA of the Ibur according to this smallness of theirs of Nefesh. And likewise, if the MAN is of Ruach, AVI couple from the phase of their external vessels of the phase of Ruach. And so too with Neshama, they couple from the phase of their internal vessels, in accordance with the MAN of the Neshama of ZA that is included in them, and so on in this manner. And the reason for this has already been well explained in the previous parts.
